title: Reset a locked workspace account
summary: Use when repeated sign-in attempts lock a user out even after the password is correct.
steps: Confirm the workspace domain | Ask an admin to open Members and choose Unlock account | Have the user reset the password | Revoke old sessions if the lock repeats

title: Restore multi-factor authentication access
summary: Use when a user replaced or lost an authenticator device and cannot complete MFA.
steps: Verify the approved recovery method | Ask a workspace owner to issue a recovery code | Enroll the new authenticator | Remove the lost device from trusted factors

title: Troubleshoot single sign-on loops
summary: Use when SSO returns a user to the login page or reports a mismatched identity.
steps: Check the email claim from the identity provider | Confirm the workspace SSO domain | Clear the stale browser session | Re-test in a private window

title: Explain duplicate card charges
summary: Use when two card transactions appear for one subscription renewal.
steps: Compare posted and pending transactions | Check invoice identifiers | Wait for a pending authorization to expire | Escalate only if two charges are posted

title: Correct an invoice tax profile
summary: Use when an invoice has the wrong company name tax number or billing address.
steps: Open Billing profile | Update legal entity and tax fields | Save before the next invoice | Request a corrected invoice from billing support

title: Resolve failed subscription renewal
summary: Use when a plan becomes past due after a renewal payment fails.
steps: Confirm the card supports recurring payments | Update the payment method | Retry the open invoice | Confirm plan access is restored

title: Recover delayed warehouse synchronization
summary: Use when records exist in the source but have not arrived in the analytics warehouse.
steps: Check the connector run timestamp | Compare the source cursor with the last checkpoint | Run a scoped incremental sync | Escalate with the run identifier if lag remains

title: Repair duplicate imported records
summary: Use when an import creates repeated rows after a retry or reconnect.
steps: Identify the stable external record key | Pause the connector | Run deduplication by external key | Resume from the last clean checkpoint

title: Handle missing fields after CSV import
summary: Use when columns are blank or shifted following a CSV upload.
steps: Confirm UTF-8 encoding | Check delimiter and header row | Map source columns in preview | Re-import a small validation sample

title: Diagnose webhook signature failures
summary: Use when webhook deliveries receive an invalid signature response.
steps: Confirm the signing secret for the environment | Preserve the raw request body | Compute HMAC before JSON parsing | Rotate the secret if exposure is suspected

title: Recover an expired API credential
summary: Use when API requests suddenly return authentication or expired-token errors.
steps: Identify the credential owner | Create a replacement with minimum scopes | Update the secret store | Revoke the expired credential after validation

title: Reduce API rate-limit errors
summary: Use when integrations receive HTTP 429 responses during bursts.
steps: Read the retry-after header | Add exponential backoff with jitter | Batch compatible requests | Monitor request volume by endpoint

title: Investigate slow dashboard loading
summary: Use when dashboards take much longer than normal to render.
steps: Check query duration and browser timing | Reduce the selected date range | Identify high-cardinality widgets | Capture the dashboard and query identifiers for escalation

title: Address report export timeouts
summary: Use when large PDF or CSV exports time out before download.
steps: Narrow the report range | Remove unused columns | Schedule the export during lower load | Split very large exports into bounded batches

title: Diagnose intermittent API latency
summary: Use when API response time spikes without consistent failures.
steps: Record endpoint request ID and timestamp | Compare p50 and p95 latency | Check retry amplification | Escalate a trace covering the slow interval
